report.summary: Patient P-D008 (age 41, Medicaid with transport benefit = yes, home tract 17031400800) needs transportation options. The most recent screener (2026-10-12) flagged no transportation worry but records a utilities shutoff concern. Eligible options: Medicaid-covered medical ride request (form-based qualification check) and the Medicaid Ride Line (call the number on the insurance card at least 2 business days ahead). ADA paratransit certification is available but takes up to 21 days. Senior Shuttle West is not eligible (age 60+ required; patient is 41).

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line
options.how_to_access: Call the number on the Medicaid card at least 2 business days before the appointment (plan members only).

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk (ADA certification)
options.how_to_access: Apply by phone for ADA paratransit certification; decisions take up to 21 days.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Not eligible — free weekday rides (7 AM–5 PM) are for adults 60+; patient is 41.
